primary_cause: Evidence is conflicting: a May 2026 report described Capesize rates reaching a two-year high on stronger demand and tightening vessel supply, while August 2026 BIMCO-related reporting warned that apparent 2026 strength was substantially driven by forced rerouting and could reverse into a 2027 supply glut. The exact current BDI/Capesize/Panamax commodity-volume cycle is therefore not sufficiently time-consistent.
counter_evidence: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk strength was substantially artificial because of forced rerouting and could reverse into a 2027 supply glut.
